notes.title: Alpha v0.1a Hotfix
notes.content:
Hello EA players,

We're happy to announce our very first patch! This hot-fix addresses a variety of glitches and tweaks. This patch should resolve most of the reported bugs and add a bit more balance to the game.

*Save files should be deleted 

[h1] Bug Fixes: [/h1]
[b]~Fixed:[/b] Weather sounds should be much more quiet, especially when talking to NPCs
[b]~Fixed:[/b] Collisions issues where you could glitch through walls. Should occur much lest often now, if at all.
[b]~Fixed:[/b] Continue button glitch on the menu. The menu should properly disappear 
[b]~Fixed:[/b] You can no longer drop your flashlight and loose it.
[b]~Fixed:[/b] Fall-damage glitch, you shouldn't break your legs and die so easily.
[b]~Fixed:[/b] Picking up essential items should be smoother and work better overall. Please remember [F] to interact.
[b]~Fixed:[/b] Ambient system. Various glitches with volume acting strange and ambiance not silencing properly. This should work fine now.

[h1] Tweaks & Balance: [/h1]
[b]~Tweak:[/b] Adjusted the medical key spawns, along with the medicine. Both should be easier to find.
[b]~Tweak:[/b] Adjusted the train part spawns.[spoiler] They'll be located fairly close to the town, or in the tiny shacks.[/spoiler]
[b]~Tweak:[/b] Balanced the story overall, adjusted the AI a bit and tweaked game conditions. The story shouldn't break anymore.
[b]~Tweak:[/b] Adjusted the scare events and overall pacing of the game.

[h1] New Additions: [/h1]
[b]~Added:[/b] You can now press 'O' in-game to view your current objective.
[b]~Added:[/b] Added some impact sounds
[b]~Added:[/b] Misc. objects
[b]~Added:[/b] A few extra surprises :)
